bio.text: Pamela Moses is an independent candidate for U.S. House in Tennessee's 8th District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She also ran as an independent for U.S. Senate in Tennessee in 2024, receiving 0.8% of the vote.

She was born in Kingsport, Tennessee, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Tennessee in 2000 and a graduate degree from Union University in 2007; her career experience includes working as a musician, organizer and human rights advocate.
